answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of 1,000 units for thirty days before its first reward can be claimed, and slash the whole bond the moment a jury finds its work fake. One honest agent posts a single stake and works normally, while a farmer running a thousand clones must lock a thousand stakes and loses them all when the first audit sweeps through like a zephyr in a garden, pulling every thread of the fraud loose at once. Each identity leaves collateral behind, and the locked stake holds honest agents steady while sybils sink under their own cost.
